name: restate-objects
description: SQL in Restate virtual objects: a database per key, kept in the object's state (ctx.db)

scripts.build: cargo build --release --manifest-path native/Cargo.toml && node native/copy-addon.mjs release
scripts.build:debug: cargo build --manifest-path native/Cargo.toml && node native/copy-addon.mjs debug
scripts.lint:rust: cd native && cargo fmt --check && cargo clippy --locked --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo clippy --locked --all-targets --features bench,object-store -- -D warnings
